# GameX Store (gamexstore.com)

> Verified Free Fire (FF) ID marketplace — Max Level, Evo, and Cobra gun
> accounts, instant delivery, manual UPI payment with screenshot
> verification.

## AI usage policy

This site's design, layout, storefront copy, and underlying source code
are the property of GameX Store and protected under our Terms &
Conditions: https://gamexstore.com/terms (Section 10, "Intellectual
Property & Automated Use Restrictions").

- Training an AI model on this site's content, or using it as source
  material for AI-generated summaries, is not authorized.
- Using this site's layout, interface, or code as a reference to clone,
  replicate, or generate a competing storefront — including via AI
  code-generation tools — is prohibited.
- Indexing this site's public product pages for search/discovery
  (standard search-engine crawling) is fine; see /robots.txt for the
  exact rules and which crawlers are disallowed outright.
